turn.content: The records settle it. Invoice 00833/KPI/2026 (2026-10-05) already billed the full received quantity of PO-2026-0048 (all 17/3/7/15 received in GR-2026-0048), and this invoice bills the identical quantities at identical prices — a total of twice what was received. There is only one goods receipt, so this is not a later delivery.

tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "possible_duplicate", "line": null, "cause": "resubmission", "evidence": [{"kind": "invoice", "ref": "00840/KPI/2026", "detail": "Current invoice, dated 2026-10-12, bills PO-2026-0048: 17 pallets @185300, 3 bubble wrap @305100, 7 stretch film @94600, 15 labels @79200, total 6566316."}, {"kind": "ledger_invoice", "ref": "00833/KPI/2026", "detail": "Earlier invoice dated 2026-10-05 against the same PO-2026-0048 with the identical total 6566316 — it already billed these quantities."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0048", "detail": "The only goods receipt for PO-2026-0048 (received 2026-10-01) records exactly 17/3/7/15 — the full ordered quantity; there is no second, later receipt."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0048", "detail": "Ordered quantities are 17/3/7/15, all already invoiced by 00833/KPI/2026, so the total invoiced for this PO (2x) exceeds what was received."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-008#4.3", "detail": "One delivery may be invoiced only once; re-submitted invoices, under the same or a different number, are rejected."}], "explanation": "This invoice re-bills, under a new number, the same quantities of PO-2026-0048 that invoice 00833/KPI/2026 already billed and that GR-2026-0048 — the only receipt for that PO — fully delivered, so the cumulatively invoiced quantity exceeds what was received."}]}
